name: Rust: wry 0.57 (raw Win32 host / tao 0.37) and Tauri 2.11 -> WebView2 153; pulldown-cmark 0.13 (GFM)

variants.notes: best (safe): wry 0.57 + minimal raw Win32 host window created hidden and shown from inside wry's controller-creation pump (overlaps show/activation with msedgewebview2 launch); env created first; custom protocol http://fastmd.localhost/ serves a first 64 KB HTML chunk, rest appended after first paint; chrome.webview.postMessage; persistent UDF %LOCALAPPDATA%/FastMD/wry; sandbox on

same as rust-webview but the host window is a tao 0.37 window (the canonical wry setup); tao's first WM_SETFOCUS builds a keyboard-layout cache (~250-400 ms, measured), overlapped with the WebView2 launch by showing the window inside the pump

minimal Tauri 2.11.5 app (tauri-build, default features, no plugins): same mdcore page via register_asynchronous_uri_scheme_protocol, invoke('msg') -> DwmFlush; UDF %LOCALAPPDATA%/FastMD/tauri; t_window is conservative (after window+webview build)
UNSAFE / unsupported, for measurement only: rust-webview + Chromium --single-process (renderer+GPU inside the browser process, no sandbox); separate UDF %LOCALAPPDATA%/FastMD/wry-single
